AP02.question: Give two hands-on tests to check whether my index fingertip releases its sticker before a slow F turn finishes. Use a title: seconds heading on each test and fit both into 64 seconds. In a separate paragraph, ask Inez in one sentence to film both tests tomorrow.

value.answer:
**Test 1: Sticker-peel check — 30 seconds**
Hold the cube still with your index finger resting on the F-face sticker, then turn F slowly over about 5 seconds while watching only the fingertip. Repeat 3–4 times within the 30 seconds, noting whether the fingertip stays in contact past the halfway point of the turn or slides off early; a clean release means the finger leaves the sticker before the turn completes.

**Test 2: Slow-motion mirror check — 34 seconds**
Do 3 slow F turns (about 6 seconds each) in front of a mirror or phone camera at close range, then spend the remaining ~16 seconds replaying or re-watching the last turn to see the exact moment the fingertip separates from the sticker. If the fingertip is still touching when the F face is nearly finished, your release is late.

Inez, could you film both tests tomorrow?

Counted-contact test: 30 seconds
Place your right index fingertip flat on the front-center sticker and do one deliberately slow F turn over 8 seconds while counting aloud from 1 to 8; note the count when the fingertip first loses contact, then reset 3 seconds and repeat twice (8 + 3 + 8 + 3 + 8 = 30). If contact ends before you say 8 in any trial, your fingertip releases before that slow F finishes.

Slow-motion frame check: 34 seconds
Set a phone to 120 fps or higher so it sees the front face and your index fingertip, record one 10-second slow F, then use 20 seconds to scrub to the last contact frame and the frame where the F face is fully turned; allow 4 seconds for setup (10 + 20 + 4 = 34). If the last contact frame comes before the completed-F frame, release happens early.

Inez, please film both tests tomorrow.

**Test 1: Sticker-peel check — 30 seconds**
Put a small paper dot or a piece of low-tack tape on the F-face sticker your index fingertip touches, then do five very slow F turns (about 5 seconds each) while watching only that sticker. If the dot/tape stays put until the turn is nearly complete and only then lifts, your fingertip is holding the sticker through the turn; if it peels away early, the fingertip is releasing too soon.

**Test 2: Fingertip-shadow check — 34 seconds**
Set a phone camera or a lamp so your fingertip casts a visible shadow on the F face, then do five slow F turns (about 5 seconds each) and watch the shadow's edge against the sticker. If the shadow stays in contact with the sticker until the turn finishes, the fingertip is still pressing; if the shadow separates from the sticker before the turn ends, the fingertip has released early.

Inez, could you film both tests tomorrow?

Tape-lift test: 24 seconds
Stick a tiny loop of low-tack tape on your index fingertip, touch the center of the F sticker, and perform one very slow F turn over about 8 seconds; repeat three times. If the tape lifts off the cube before the F face finishes turning, your fingertip is releasing the sticker early; if contact lasts until the turn finishes, release is late.

Marker-drag test: 40 seconds
Put a small dry-erase dot on a spare F sticker, press your index fingertip on it, and do four 10-second slow F turns, checking after each. If the dot stops smearing or your fingertip leaves the sticker before the face is fully turned, release is early; if the smear continues to the end, release is at the finish.

Inez, please film both tests tomorrow.

AP01.question: 设计两项可操作的检查，看慢转 R 层停止之前右手中指是否抬离起始贴纸。合计不超过五十六秒，各标题用「名称：秒数」。另起一段写一句话直接请明宇周六把两段录像中的提前离面时刻做标记。

value.answer:
1. 慢放逐帧比对：20秒
用手机以慢动作模式拍一次慢转 R 层，回放时逐帧找出右手中指离开起始贴纸的那一帧和 R 层停住的那一帧，比较两帧先后，确认中指是否在停止前抬起。

2. 贴纸标记目视追踪：36秒
在起始贴纸旁贴一小块胶带作固定参照，慢转 R 层时眼睛盯住中指指尖与胶带的相对位置，在层停住的瞬间判断指尖是否已离开贴纸，并立刻口头记下“先离”或“同时”。

明宇，周六请把两段录像中提前离面的时刻都标出来。
